result:
I implemented `Uint8Array.fromHex` and a `pub(crate)` `fromhex(agent, string, max_length)` helper in `from_hex.rs`, with the spec steps as comments. `./t262 built-ins/Uint8Array/fromHex/` passes 18/18 runs (9 files), and `cargo clippy` is clean.

I named the helper `fromhex` because `from_hex` is already the built-in. It returns a `(read, bytes, error)` tuple, so `setFromHex` can pass a `max_length` and read all three parts. I used a tuple rather than a struct to avoid a dead-code warning on the unread `read` field, since `setFromHex` isn't implemented yet. I added no lint suppressions.
